description.value: The Heid Out is a downtown Cranbrook institution combining a full-service restaurant with an on-site craft brewery producing Fisher Peak beers, brewed in 1000-litre tanks and poured fresh from tap. Five Red Seal chefs drive a kitchen that ranges from South Indian Masala to Kootenay-inspired burgers, drawing on hyper-local suppliers and the restaurant's own dedicated celiac-friendly kitchen area — a rarity in the region. The outdoor patio welcomes dogs, and private event spaces make it a natural gathering point for groups passing through the Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong primary evidence. The business is an active restaurant and brewhouse at 821 Baker Street, Cranbrook — matching the OSM address and phone number exactly. No bike parking, bike rack, or water refill is mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; the menu pages confirm vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options explicitly, and the navigation includes 'ORDER ONLINE' confirming takeout. OSM name uses 'Heidout' (one word) while the website consistently spells it 'Heid Out' (two words), flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name spelling discrepancy: OSM records 'The Heidout Restaurant & Brewhouse' (one word, ampersand) but the website consistently uses 'The Heid Out Restaurant and Brewhouse' (two words, 'and'). OSM name retained per schema rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating restaurant and brewhouse in downtown Cranbrook with food, drink, and accessibility features — a clear benefit to touring cyclists moving through the Kootenays.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegan Menu' and 'GLUTEN FREE MENU' as separate menu categories; individual items are tagged (V) for vegetarian and (GFP) for gluten-free-possible throughout; homepage highlights 'Cranbrook's only dedicated celiac-friendly kitchen area'
